verdict.rationale: Inline commenting is a fair question for a work-management product like monday.com, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows item-level 'updates' and @mentions, which are general item conversations, not comments anchored to specific text or images in an item's description. That is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can comment directly on specific text or images within an item's description
